title: Fruza Cherry Raspberry Ice 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Introducing Cherry Raspberry Ice by Fruza Nic Salts, a brilliantly bold and refreshing fruit and ice combination. This flavour captures the deep, sweet notes of ripe Cherries and contrasts them perfectly with the bright, tangy burst of fresh Raspberries. This vibrant fruit medley is finished with a crisp, cooling ice effect, delivering a balanced and refreshing vape from inhale to exhale. The Fruza Nic Salts range is crafted for vapers seeking clear, intense, and authentic flavours. Inspired by Japanese precision and artistry, each 10ml e-liquid features a double concentration of flavour, designed to provide a rich and punchy taste experience. With a 50% VG / 50% PG blend, this e-liquid is perfectly balanced for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. It produces a discreet amount of vapour while carrying flavour exceptionally well. The nicotine salt formulation ensures a smooth throat hit, even at higher nicotine levels, providing satisfying and rapid nicotine relief. Fruza Nic Salts are available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, making them a versatile choice for a wide range of vapers. They are ideal for use in low-wattage pod vape kits and starter vape kits This 10ml e-liquid is TPD-compliant, featuring a childproof cap and a tamper-evident seal for your safety. All Fruza e-liquid is made in the UK with high-quality ingredients for a premium and reliable vape.
